name: custom-css
description: The custom CSS of the settings reaches the chrome, and the chrome wears it.

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('custom_css'); field.value = ':root{--accent:#ff6600}'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return field.value;
steps.why: a custom colour is typed into the settings
the app has a moment to apply and to save
the chrome wears the custom colour
the custom CSS sits in the chrome's own style element

steps.expression: const style = document.getElementById('uiKitStyle'); const custom = document.getElementById('customCssStyle'); return !!(style && custom) && (style.compareDocumentPosition(custom) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING) === Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING;
steps.why: the custom CSS comes after the shared kit, so it wins
a button of the chrome is painted with the custom colour
